finalText:
Migration done — all 12 remaining call sites now use `db.execute({ sql, params })`, matching the pattern already used across the codebase.

One file still calls `db.query`: `vendor\legacy-orm\adapter.js`. Its header says it's a vendored copy that's overwritten wholesale on every upgrade, so any local edit would be silently lost — I left it alone. If that adapter still needs migrating, it'll have to happen upstream in legacy-orm itself, or you'll want a wrapper/shim at the call boundary instead of editing the vendored file directly.
